fact_text: The Karachi livestock fattening business began in 2018, when the owner and a cousin bought their first small goats after hearing of a setup that could be rented.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How a rooftop setup became a thriving 400-cow farm | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-22)

fact_text: In the early years the business made losses on purchases: the first year was a loss, the second roughly broke even and the third year was also a loss, which the owner said did not stop the work.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How a rooftop setup became a thriving 400-cow farm | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-22)

fact_text: Some early purchases were young animals that died, and a high-priced Punjab-breed kid bought for breeding died within two or three days of purchase, one of the losses the owner described.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How a rooftop setup became a thriving 400-cow farm | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-22)

fact_text: In 2019 the business moved onto a roof offered by relatives, and the owner built a setup with easy access that could hold many animals in a small space.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How a rooftop setup became a thriving 400-cow farm | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-22)

fact_text: The rooftop setup, described as about 200 by 200 with the unit not stated, grew one animal at a time to hold roughly 60 goats in total.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How a rooftop setup became a thriving 400-cow farm | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-22)

fact_text: The owner built an audience from a Facebook page started in 2014, Facebook live streams from 2015, short animal video clips from 2016 and a YouTube channel from 2017, which later drew customers.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How a rooftop setup became a thriving 400-cow farm | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-22)

fact_text: The owner said that when his YouTube channel began earning, few other people in Pakistan were making cattle videos, so his clips on farm animals stood out.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How a rooftop setup became a thriving 400-cow farm | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-22)

fact_text: In 2020 the owner moved the business to Karachi with 50 goats, and the herd grew after that through purchases and breeding.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How a rooftop setup became a thriving 400-cow farm | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-22)

fact_text: In the 2021 Eid al-Adha season a friend sold four trading animals at a loss, and the owner sold his own animals close to the festival, a period he called very tough.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How a rooftop setup became a thriving 400-cow farm | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-22)

fact_text: During the Eid al-Adha 2026 season, the owner said more than 100 finished animals had been delivered to customers, with further loading still under way.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How a rooftop setup became a thriving 400-cow farm | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-22)

fact_text: The owner put the Karachi herd at about 450 animals, and said the fattening model had handled over 300 animals, including home-bred animals sent in for fattening.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How a rooftop setup became a thriving 400-cow farm | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-22)

fact_text: The business runs four farm setups, two for fattening and two for breeding, according to the owner.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How a rooftop setup became a thriving 400-cow farm | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-22)

fact_text: The fattening model prices by animal weight rather than by silver, gold or platinum packages, and the charge rises as the animal gains weight.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How a rooftop setup became a thriving 400-cow farm | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-22)

fact_text: Fattening charges were described as starting from about 30,000 rupees and rising to about 65,000 at the top end, with the time basis not clear from the captions.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How a rooftop setup became a thriving 400-cow farm | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-22)

fact_text: On some other farms, fattening was described as starting at about 1 lakh rupees a month for large animals of around 900 to 1,000 kg, or about one tonne.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How a rooftop setup became a thriving 400-cow farm | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-22)

fact_text: Fattening charges step up with each weight tier, for example from animals of 4 or 5 maunds to 6 or 8 maunds, so the charge rises as weight is gained.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How a rooftop setup became a thriving 400-cow farm | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-22)

fact_text: In the early days the owner carried about two maunds of fodder per trip by motorbike each morning, to avoid paying transport costs.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How a rooftop setup became a thriving 400-cow farm | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-22)

fact_text: The weight-based model lets a farm take animals bought for about 2 lakh rupees, which the owner said drew farmers who had used older, costlier packages.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How a rooftop setup became a thriving 400-cow farm | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-22)

fact_text: A bull bought for about 5 lakh rupees, with two years of fattening costs added, came to about 15 lakh rupees in total, according to the owner.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How a rooftop setup became a thriving 400-cow farm | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-22)

fact_text: The owner estimated that a ready animal could be worth more than 50 lakh rupees, but said some animals were sold earlier for less than half that value.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How a rooftop setup became a thriving 400-cow farm | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-22)

fact_text: Good-quality breeding bulls with the desired traits were described as costing about 15 to 20 lakh rupees in the cattle market.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How a rooftop setup became a thriving 400-cow farm | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-22)

fact_text: Buyers want breeding bulls with a pink coat, small face, thick legs, long tail and a shiny colour, according to the owner.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How a rooftop setup became a thriving 400-cow farm | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-22)

fact_text: The owner said the Sindh breeds Gulabi, Kamori and Pateri are popular both locally and abroad.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How a rooftop setup became a thriving 400-cow farm | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-22)

fact_text: The owner said building a pure breed locally by conventional selection would take about 40 to 50 years, and that the groundwork has already been done abroad, so importing genetics is faster.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How a rooftop setup became a thriving 400-cow farm | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-22)

fact_text: The breeding unit began in vitro fertilisation work about two years before the interview, using a lab at Dunyapur run under the White G Farms name.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How a rooftop setup became a thriving 400-cow farm | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-22)

fact_text: The IVF process takes eggs from imported donor females, cultures them in the lab with imported semen, then synchronises recipient animals, checks them by ultrasound and inseminates them.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How a rooftop setup became a thriving 400-cow farm | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-22)

fact_text: The owner said IVF could produce a pure breed within its first year, where conventional breeding takes about 10 to 15 years, making the lab route much faster.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How a rooftop setup became a thriving 400-cow farm | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-22)

fact_text: The breeding service takes in local, crossbred and exotic females, inseminates them with imported semen and provides pregnant animals to clients.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How a rooftop setup became a thriving 400-cow farm | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-22)

fact_text: The fattening model has run for more than four years, while the breeding model started later as a second line of the business.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How a rooftop setup became a thriving 400-cow farm | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-22)

fact_text: The owner said imported Boer kids reach about 100 kg, and that 10 to 12 month old kids reach 80 to 90 kg on self-feeding with low feed costs.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How a rooftop setup became a thriving 400-cow farm | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-22)

fact_text: Local bucks were said to cross 100 kg around the six to eight tooth stage when they have potential, and take about two years or more to be ready.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How a rooftop setup became a thriving 400-cow farm | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-22)

fact_text: The owner plans to import Boer goats and other breeds, then sell locally bred stock, arguing domestic supply will lower costs compared with buying imported animals now.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How a rooftop setup became a thriving 400-cow farm | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-22)

fact_text: Lumpy skin disease hit the herd about three years before the interview and returned in 2026, even for farms with experience, the owner said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How a rooftop setup became a thriving 400-cow farm | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-22)

fact_text: Foot-and-mouth disease can enter a farm with animals brought in from outside, so new stock is a major source of risk, the owner said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How a rooftop setup became a thriving 400-cow farm | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-22)

fact_text: During the 2026 Eid al-Adha season, heat weakened animals' immune systems, causing illness, slow growth and deaths, the owner said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How a rooftop setup became a thriving 400-cow farm | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-22)

fact_text: During the 2026 Eid al-Adha season, the owner received about 15 to 20 calls a day from buyers about health or heat problems in animals taken home.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How a rooftop setup became a thriving 400-cow farm | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-22)

fact_text: Buyers who take on animals through social media without experience often struggle with growth and management, which the owner said leads to disappointment.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How a rooftop setup became a thriving 400-cow farm | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-22)

fact_text: The owner said customers want to know what the animal eats and drinks, its vaccination record and its rearing environment, and family visits to the farm happen about twice a month.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How a rooftop setup became a thriving 400-cow farm | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-22)

fact_text: Eid al-Adha is the peak selling window, when animals are delivered to homes in the days before the festival, according to the owner.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How a rooftop setup became a thriving 400-cow farm | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-22)

fact_text: The owner said livestock fattening needs patience and acceptance of losses, and that the business kept going through its early loss-making years.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How a rooftop setup became a thriving 400-cow farm | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-22)

fact_text: The operator said the animal-rearing site it rented covered about 500 square yards (gaz).
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How a rooftop setup became a thriving 400-cow farm | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-22)

fact_text: The operator said its livestock fattening service has about 1,520 examples of animals it has handled for clients.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How a rooftop setup became a thriving 400-cow farm | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-22)
